scope: corrected small synthetic-only paired event-only pose rerun; generic Genesis cuboid, not E-POSE real evaluation
purpose: replay the repaired per-interval event windows and reach the pinned SingleShotPose confidence-loss phase after its 15-epoch coordinate pretrain

upstream_model.initialization: random paired initialization; LINEMOD weights are not used

input.source: raw events from the paired EventGenesis or V2E stream
input.window: (t_i,t_i+1], with the right endpoint exactly equal to the shared pose-label time

labels.source: shared Genesis target pose, camera pose, actual camera K, and configured box dimensions
labels.time_reference: right endpoint of event window; persisted for every sample
labels.single_shot_pose_format: class, projected centroid, eight projected 3D cuboid corners, normalized x/y extent

training.loss: pinned SingleShotPose RegionLoss coordinate pretraining; confidence term is enabled only in epoch 16
training.budget_note: With 8 train windows, this pilot performs 128 updates per generator; only the final 8 updates include confidence loss, so it is a diagnostic gate rather than a tuned final recipe.

additional_synthetic_only_checks: ground-truth centroid-cell decode to separate keypoint regression from confidence-cell selection
train-mode batch-stat decode with BN buffers restored after each diagnostic probe
record BN running-stat hashes and num_batches_tracked in checkpoint result metadata
record sample_id, rollout_id, event_start_s, event_end_s, label_time_s, and independently recountable event_count
